description: This file defines the EmailService interface, providing method signatures for sending emails, retrieving, and saving email configurations within the system.

classes.name: EmailService
classes.description: Interface specifying email-related operations such as sending emails and managing email configurations.

methods.name: sendHtmlEmail
methods.description: Sends an HTML email for a specific store, may throw service or generic exceptions.

methods.name: getEmailConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the email configuration for a given store, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: saveEmailConfiguration
methods.description: Saves the provided email configuration for a store, may throw ServiceException.
